name: ShapeY
description: Object recognition (OR) in humans relies heavily on shape cues and the ability to recognize objects across varying 3D viewpoints. Unlike humans, deep networks often rely on non-shape cues such as texture and background, leading to vulnerabilities in generalization and robustness. To address this gap, we introduce ShapeY, a novel and principled benchmarking framework designed to evaluate shape-based recognition capability in OR systems. ShapeY comprises 68,200 grayscale images of 200 3D objects rendered from multiple viewpoints and optionally subjected to non-shape ``appearance'' changes.
